report.title: Incident Report — Cedar Fork Basin Solvent Contamination
report.executiveSummary: The AquaSentinel swarm detected an industrial solvent contamination event originating near the CF-14 industrial corridor at 06:00 UTC on July 29, 2026. Sensing and Hydrodynamic agents localized the source and modeled a plume trajectory reaching the Downtown Municipal Intake (CF-19) within approximately 4 hours. The Regulatory Compliance Agent identified Cedarline Solvent Processing Plant (FAC-07) as the sole permitted solvent discharger within range, with measured concentrations 3.4x above its permitted limit. A human operator approved the recommended emergency containment order at 06:19 UTC.

timeline.thought: Two adjacent sensors both show elevated conductivity and depressed pH — check for a point source.
Given flow rate 7.1 m3/s at CF-14 and downstream topology, model plume travel time to CF-19.
timeline.conclusion: Downtown intake at risk within the response window.

timeline.thought: Cross-reference contaminant signature against factories with industrial_solvent permits near CF-14.
timeline.observation: FAC-07 is the sole permitted solvent discharger within 500m of CF-14.
timeline.conclusion: FAC-07 is the most likely violator; measured levels exceed permit by 3.4x.

evidenceSummary.description: Anomalous pH drop and conductivity spike at CF-14, consistent with solvent discharge.
Flow model places CF-19 municipal intake within predicted plume path within 4 hours.
FAC-07 discharge limit for industrial_solvent is 0.5 mg/L; measured concentration implies ~3.4x exceedance.

recommendation.summary: Issue emergency containment order to Factory FAC-07 and notify downstream municipalities before plume reaches CF-19 intake.
recommendation.primaryHypothesis: Industrial solvent discharge from FAC-07 exceeding permitted limits by 3.4x.

actions.title: Issue emergency containment order
actions.description: Halt discharge at FAC-07 pending inspection.
actions.estimatedEnvironmentalImpact: Prevents further spread to downtown municipal intake within 4-hour window.

actions.title: Notify downtown water treatment operators
actions.description: Advise CF-19 intake operators of predicted contamination arrival ~10:00 UTC.
actions.estimatedEnvironmentalImpact: Enables intake filtration adjustment or temporary shutoff.

approvalRecord.notes: Confirmed with field team, proceeding with containment order.
